bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised two-student project, implemented reusable Python modules for the workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, used scikit-learn TF-IDF features and a logistic-regression classifier on public news summaries; evaluated a fixed held-out split using macro F-score and example errors.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As an individual contribution to a supervised two-student project, implemented reusable Python modules for the retrieval workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries using scikit-learn and sentence-transformers; examined recall at fixed cutoffs and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using pandas merges and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution within a supervised research team, implemented reusable Python modules for the workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration in public product reviews; examined topic stability across repeated fits and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
